items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: Yeah, I played music with him. And, uh, he plays guitar too.

ctx.x: Whereabouts? Whereabouts? Where, which, which bars? Where are, where are they? Yeah, yeah. It doesn't make any difference. Does it make them any difference? Huh? Do they care? Do they, are they glad to see you come in and play? Well, some of them do.

Yeah. Some of them, yeah. I'm glad that I came in and play. And just, with me and a, this friend, was playing with me at, we stayed right over there. Stayed right over there. He was over there this morning. Uh-huh. And me and him was over there. Right down in street camp, right down in the school there. Uh-huh. And, uh, little lady comes to me, Quest Davis. Yeah, Quest. Yeah. But, they come, come to me over there, right there, that's the town, I was told over there. Uh-huh. He was in the car. He gave me about,…
